preconditions.description: The number of cards n must be between 1 and 100.
The required total power k must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= 1000 and 1 <= ci <= 100000 and 1 <= li <= n for pi, ci, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's power, magic number, and level must be within their respective bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible_deck else min_level >= 1
postconditions.description: If no valid deck can be formed, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum level Vova needs to reach.

postconditions.expression: sum(pi for pi, _, _ in cards if pi in selected_cards) >= k
postconditions.description: The total power of the selected cards must be at least k.

postconditions.expression: not any(is_prime(ci + cj) for i in range(len(selected_cards)) for j in range(i + 1, len(selected_cards)))
postconditions.description: No two selected cards should have magic numbers that sum to a prime number.
